cn: ⭐AEE - 外觀編輯拓展 更新
調整服裝試穿功能現在在更衣狀態額外做一個按鈕控制停用
新增拘束試穿功能(在設定頁與服裝試穿同一個總按鈕)
新增隱藏預覽顯示角色的按鈕，仍保持替換髮型的預覽效果
新增隱藏興奮條與其他ICON功能(與LCE、HHA功能一致，不衝突)
新增自由繪圖顯示繪圖邊界
新增自由繪圖能匯入圖片(測試功能)
修復隱藏或顯示kaomoji的功能(/xsa kaomoji show|hide)
替換了信息發送按鈕的功能(右下角)
能常駐、隱藏、排序按鈕，並自定義按鈕數量
en: Adjusted the outfit try-on feature; it now has an additional toggle button in the dressing state to disable the function.
Added a restraint try-on feature (shares the same master toggle as outfit try-on in the settings page).
Added a button to hide the character preview while still maintaining the hairstyle replacement preview effect.
Added a function to hide the arousal meter and other icons (consistent with LCE and HHA features, no conflicts).
Added a feature to display drawing boundaries in Free Draw.
Added image import support for Free Draw (experimental).
Fixed the kaomoji hide/show function (/xsa kaomoji show|hide).
Replaced the function of the message send button.
Now supports permanently displaying, hiding, and reordering buttons, with customizable button count.
